notes: New: emotes (number keys 1-9 in fights, quick chat like Pass it / Help / Switch in Hoops, your opponent sees them), key binds in Settings, a Suggest button for your ideas, pick your grade once (Global chat is split by grade), a bigger update alert, a nicer chat, and invite friends right from the private match screens. Join codes are now 4 digits. Online connects more reliably, even on networks that block the usual link. Online fights run at normal speed again. Hoops: defense gets the edge on rebounds and greens glow at the rim for everyone. Racer: save your tracks and build one together online. Announcements stay on screen until closed. The emote buttons sit on the side now so they never cover your moves, and chat lines a moderator deletes disappear for everyone. The Pixel Pass has 20 more rewards every season (a themed outfit set, name colours, underglow, titles), your title and name colour show in chat, and the Street Shop has over 200 new things to wear (crowns, headphones, halos, horns, cowboy hats, new patterns, more colours of everything) plus more paints and stripes for your car. Hoops Story Mode is 2K-style now: every game gets a grade and pays coins (more for playing than simming, and more in the playoffs), plus goals to hit each game. Spend coins on attributes, badges and better teammates, and build rep to raise how high your attributes can go. Online fights: the host can now pick the stats for the match: your real stats, base stats, maxed out (every stat maxed with every move unlocked), or match the better player in the lobby. New mode: Riches to Rags, rags to riches played backwards. You start as a god (200 in every stat, wild custom moves and powers you pick yourself) in an open street full of gangs, and every kill makes you weaker: your moves reset and you pick again from worse and worse options until you're at base stats, and one more kill wins. Die and you're back in 3 seconds with what you had. Other players in the mode share the same street, and you can fight each other. Supers: from rebirth 2 you can buy new supers with cash in the Super Shop (open it from your fighter's Train screen) and pick which one the U key throws, with 10 new ones to choose from. At rebirth 5 whichever super you've equipped becomes the gold Ascended Super. Online fights use the super you have equipped. Pause in fights, Hoops and Racer is only the Escape key now (P no longer opens the menu). You can sign in with Google (Settings): it's optional, and it backs your fighters, Hoops story and Racer progress up to your account, so a wiped browser or a new device can't lose them. Sign in again and everything comes back; if two devices have different progress you're asked which to keep. While a game update is going out, the game pauses and shows a "please hold" screen.
